title: In Dropping Reflecting Pool Case, Pirro Draws Trump’s Wrath

title: Justice Dept. Subpoenas Times Freelancer in Effort to Identify Sources

title: After Most Migrants Leave Ceuta, Exhausted Holdouts Find Shelter on Beach
summary: Most of the people who surged into Spain on Thursday have since returned to Morocco. A small minority are holed up on a seafront, tired, hungry and vowing to stay.
